szenen.text: Altcoins look exactly like Coinbase did a month ago. And that did not end well.
Coinbase: three rising peaks, then back down to a horizontal support. A month ago that floor broke, and the stock kept falling.
Now look at TOTAL2, the whole crypto market without Bitcoin. Same three peaks. And now it is sitting right on the same kind of floor.
Our view: Coinbase is just leading. We expect TOTAL2 to break this support, and take the altcoins down with it.
